spans.s: potta, cf. milita-potta-drammā (LP), collected government money. Cf. potra.

potaka (LP), the government's money-bag.
 (LP), cf. Gujarātī poluṃ; the amount of revenue of a village sent to the Government treasury. Cf. pottaka.
pottaka (LP), same as Gujarātī potuṃ; the amount of the revenue of a village sent to the government treasury. Cf. potaka.
potra (EI 26), name of a tax. Cf. potta.
